method.original: Unmodified scripts/measure-performance.mjs; external copy only resolves the existing Playwright import. Day/night each three samples per phase; phone low one sample per phase. CPU1x / reduced motion / DPR1 / 5 seconds.
method.dynamic: Full scene dynamics / CPU4x / DPR1 / wind8m/s / no vessels or birds / fixed scene date2026-10-31T12:00. Day, storm, phone-low storm each three samples per phase. Each sample is a fresh Chrome process, one-second post-entry settle and five-second sample. No CPU profiler during these samples. Forced original quality; GPU runs sequentially and application source frozen.
method.frameCost: frameStart at entry to the existing tick; renderStart immediately before renderer.render. update=renderStart-frameStart, render=return-renderStart, total=update+render. P50/P95 within each sample; comparisons use the median of three sample quantiles. Synchronous CPU work, not GPU completion time.
notes: The desktop refresh cap remains approximately60FPS and the original phone low-quality pacing approximately30FPS. CPU reduction does not prove a GPU or battery improvement.
The phone is a desktop Chrome viewport/CPU simulation, not physical mobile hardware.
Profiler evidence identifies initial hot spots only; the timing comparison uses the independent non-profiled samples.
Only three application modules changed. Geometry, material/texture assets, lighting, shaders, scene content, update cadence and quality policy were not edited.

baselineFixture.note: SHA-256 of original Float32 cloth and precipitation buffers, plus 4200 Float64 water samples. Captured before any application edits on 2026-11-12; regenerate only after explicit visual or simulation changes.
